title: Jazzy Venezuelan Rice Fried-Rice
description: A lazy Sunday treat that blends tangy vinegar with chewy, stir-fried rice for a quick, FODMAP-friendly feast.
instructions: Rinse the parboiled rice until water runs clear and let it drain fully.
In a small pot, combine the rinsed rice with 2 1/2 cups water and a pinch of salt, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced carrots and frozen peas to the skillet, stir‑frying for 3 minutes until they soften.
Push the vegetables to the side of the skillet and pour in the egg whites, scrambling until just set.
Add the cooled rice to the skillet, then drizzle the vinegar, tamari, sesame oil, and grated ginger, stirring to coat all grains evenly.
Season with chili flakes if using and fold in the sliced green onion, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more tamari or vinegar as desired.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving dish, sprinkle with chopped cilantro, and serve hot.
